question: PGS005206 passed all technical checks (checksum match to pin DR-0001, 81/81 variants matched, 0 effect-allele mismatches, 20/20 individuals QC PASS on synthetic data), but the Validation Critic refused release (V6b_request_phenotype_correspondence). The score's own PGS Catalog trait fields say only 'Bone mineral density' with no skeletal site; the total-body site comes only from its linked source GWAS (GCST005348, 'Total body bone mineral density'), and the only catalog evaluation is a single European pediatric cohort (Generation R, n=3470). Do you (a) explicitly approve using PGS005206 as a total-body BMD score on the basis of the linked GWAS, accepting these limitations, (b) approve changing the target phenotype to generic 'Bone mineral density', or (c) want the run stopped without released scores, so that an alternative score with an explicit total-body BMD label can be sought in a new run?
justification: The critic's FAIL is non-retryable and its remediation requires abstention or explicit researcher approval, which I cannot grant or assume. The remaining budget cannot support finding, vetting and scoring an alternative, so the researcher decision is the best-supported outcome.
